definitions: Selected or marked for favor or special privilege
thought: When God has selected you, it doesn't matter who else has rejected or neglected you. God's favor outweighs all opposition.

definitions: To release from blame or debt; clear
To free from the consequences of sin
To change for the better; reform
thought: No matter how far you've gone, you can always turn around.

definitions: To persevere in spite of risk or difficulty
thought: Traditionally lean in has been used in the context of sports to mean “to shift one's body weight forward or toward someone or something.” In water and snow sports, you can lean into a wave, the wind, a slope, or a turn. You can lean into a pitch, or throw, or catch as well. In life when the unexpected, inexplicable, and impossible presents itself you can lean into God.

subtitle: Are you preoccupied?
definitions: Fail to notice, hear, or understand
A piece of information that is sent or given to someone
Thinking or worrying about something too much
thought: We often miss hearing God's voice simply because we aren't paying attention.

definitions: A series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end
thought: Sometimes what God requires of you may not make sense, sometimes you may not see a way out, and sometimes what you're asking God to do may appear to have gone unheard, in these moments, just trust the process.
God is preparing you for greater things.

closingVerse.text: And we know [with great confidence] that God [who is deeply concerned about us] causes all things to work together [as a plan] for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to His plan and purpose.

definitions: Felt to be incapable of being done, attained, or fulfilled: insuperably difficult
thought: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

definitions: To look out or about, keep watch. To peer into the distance. To observe, await, behold.
thought: In the Bible watchmen were responsible for warning the cities of impending attacks from the enemy. You are the watchmen over your lives, your jobs, family, friends, church, neighbors, city, and state. You are a watchman but when God seeks you will he find you on your post?

subtitle: The God Who Sees Me

keyVerse.text: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me? Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

readings: He sees you in your private moments; He sees your needs
God sees you when it seems as if all is lost
thought: No matter what situation you find yourself in, moments when you feel you've gone too far, or feel alone. Know that God sees you because God is omnipresent, that is, present everywhere.

To be deeply committed and connected to someone or something.
Compassionate. Showing undeserved forgiveness or kindness.
thought: God is merciful!

closingVerse.text: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love. The Lord is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

keyVerse.text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

thought: Knowing your battle level means that you know what life and God has equipped you to fight. As you read this week’s lesson notice that there were moments when battles were fought alone, some people couldn't go into battle with them, some saw themselves as less than/unable to win, and others sought God when the battle was too great. Remember Philippians 4:13 as you face the battles of life, for with God your battle level is different than when you are fighting alone.

thought: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?

thought: For many are called, but few are chosen.

What does love look like? It has the hands to help others. It has the feet to hasten to the poor and needy. It has eyes to see misery and want. It has the ears to hear the sighs and sorrows of men. That is what love looks like.

thought: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

definitions: A place where a battle is fought
thought: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, and a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the LORD thy God is with thee, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

thought: To wait with expectancy, means to wait with intention.

thought: Jehovah-Shammah is the God who is here for all of us who cry out, today, tomorrow, and forever. This name promises his presence.
